verdict.rationale: CT Corporation is a registered-agent provider, so accepting service of process at a physical office and scanning it the same day is a fair question for this product. However, both evidence items are only robots.txt probes: one hit a Cloudflare challenge and the other was a redirect. Neither contains any content about service-of-process handling, office locations, or scanning turnaround, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, service of process is accepted at a real street office and scanned into my account the same day it is received
